messages:
Renee: Quick sync from today's marketplace procurement call  they want a deterministic "commit sculpt" that shows how credits, discounts, and SI payments interact over Y1 and renewal. Can we sketch a small playbook here?
Marco: Suggest a three-part construct: (1) list discount on commit, (2) "sculpt" credits that vest monthly for first 6 months, (3) SI success payments tied to onboarding SLOs.
Ivy: For procurement clarity, avoid refund language. Call it "vested credits" that are applied to future invoices or SI invoices. Also include a clear CSV reconciliation cadence.
Chris: Draft numbers for an example: $400k commit -> 15% discount on list, $24k sculpt credits (vest $4k/mo), SI success $15k at 90d. If usage after 6mo < pro-rata, remaining sculpt credit can be applied to next term up to 50% or used to offset SI fees.
Renee: Love it. Add a renewal make-good: if trailing 3mo utilization < 60% and customer opts to continue, we offer a one-time 3mo extension + apply up to 30% of remaining sculpt credit as uplift.
Marco: Legal: require a remediation plan signed by both parties to unlock any applied credit. Also non-stacking clause: private-offer credits cannot combine with marketplace promo credits without RevOps approval.
Ivy: Marketplace UX: SKU label should be compact: "Redwood Commit (PrivOffer) - 1Y" and attach a short PDF with the commit details. Marketplace cards truncate, so avoid long text.
Chris: Ops: meter parity clause needed. Marketplace meter vs internal meter must reconcile within 10 business days; disputes raised within 45 days. Also we need a telemetry tag on private-offers so RevOps can filter them.
Renee: Announcement rhythm: don't publish the private-offer until SI toolkit + partner marketing assets exist. Prefer: joint announcement 7 days after close, marketplace listing 14 days after close.
partner-bot: Task created: commit-sculpt-playbook -> owner: Renee, due_in: 3 business days (id: PS-4302).
Marco: I'll draft the short contract bullets for remediation + renewal make-good.
Ivy: I'll own SKU naming + the private-offer attachment template.
Chris: I'll add telemetry tagging and the reconciliation CSV spec.
Renee: Great, will collect and circulate a single-page playbook + 3 calc scenarios (fast ramp / slow ramp / partial adoption) by Fri EOD.
